description: Raw Polymarket L2 event tape for ONE time window (at most 24 hours) on one or more outcome tokens, oldest first, from the recorded order-book feed. `token_id` / `token_ids` are ERC-1155 OUTCOME token ids (long decimal strings: read them off `clob_token_ids` in polymarket_market_detail or `outcomes[].token_id` in polymarket_markets); a market's condition_id (0x...) will NOT work. Event types: `trade` (price = probability in [0, 1], size = shares, side = buy | sell), `price_change`, `book` (the whole ladder in `bids` / `asks`, JSON carried as strings), `tick_size_change` (the new tick in `tick_size`, a field no other row has; from November 2026, earlier days have none), `status`. Always pass `event_type`: without it a page is mostly price_change and book rows. Returns {events, has_more, next_cursor}; pass next_cursor back as `cursor` for the next page. A 0 in `best_bid`, `best_ask`, `price` or `size` on a row type that does not populate it means absent, not a price of 0; `best_bid` and `best_ask` are recorded only since 2026-11-05 18:02 UTC, on `price_change` and `book` rows. The tape carries no wallet addresses. `to_ms` is EXCLUSIVE here, unlike `to` in polymarket_ohlcv.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; resumes strictly after it.

event_type.description: Return only this event type. Strongly recommended.

from_ms.description: Required. Window start, epoch MILLISECONDS, inclusive.

limit.description: Events per page (default 100, max 50000, as REST /events).

to_ms.description: Required. Window end, epoch MILLISECONDS, EXCLUSIVE. Must be greater than `from_ms` and at most 86400000 (24 hours) after it.

token_id.description: One outcome token id (decimal string). Give this or `token_ids`.

token_ids.description: Comma-separated outcome token ids, at most 100. Wins over `token_id` when both are given.

name: polymarket_tape
title: Polymarket Tape
